name: Barbital
summary: The first commercially available barbiturate. Was used commonly as a sleeping aid until the 1950s.

pharmacology.text: Barbital was considered to be a great improvement over the existing hypnotics. Its taste was slightly bitter, but better than the strong, unpleasant taste of the commonly used bromides.

uses.text: Barbital (or barbitone), sold under the brand names Veronal for the pure acid and Medinal for the sodium salt, was the first commercially available barbiturate. It was used as a sleeping aid (hypnotic) from 1903 until the mid-1950s.

summaryZh: 巴比妥（英語：barbital）又稱巴比通是第一個商品化的巴比妥類藥物，其最早的純酸商品名為佛羅拿，最早的鈉鹽商品名為麥地那。

sideEffects.en: It causes drowsiness, poor coordination, slurred speech and confusion, and it leaves the body slowly so effects can carry over. Overdose can stop breathing and be fatal. Regular use brings dependence, and stopping suddenly can cause seizures that can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成嗜睡、協調變差、口齒不清與混亂，而且排出體外的速度慢，作用可能延續到隔天。過量可能使呼吸停止而致命。規律使用會造成依賴，突然停藥可能引起危及生命的癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成嗜睡、协调制差、口齿不清与混乱，而且排出体外的速度慢，作用可能延续到隔天。过量可能使呼吸停止而致命。规律使用会造成依赖，突然停药可能引起危及生命的癫痫发作。

fact.en: Barbital, sold as Veronal from 1903, was the first barbiturate on the market. Emil Fischer and Joseph von Mering made it, and the story goes that Mering named it after Verona, a city he found peaceful.
fact.zh: 巴比妥於 1903 年以 Veronal 之名販售，是市場上第一種巴比妥類藥物。它由 Emil Fischer 與 Joseph von Mering 合成，據說 Mering 以他認為寧靜的城市維洛納為它命名。
fact.zhHans: 巴比妥于 1903 年以 Veronal 之名贩售，是市场上第一种巴比妥类药物。它由 Emil Fischer 与 Joseph von Mering 合成，据说 Mering 以他认为宁静的城市维洛纳为它命名。
